summary: Import-time fetch to mutable third-party GitHub branch for log banner
details: On require('@alannxd/baileys'), lib/index.js unconditionally fetches https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alannzxd/xclient/refs/heads/main/information.json and prints the first element of the JSON array to the console via chalk. The response is not evaluated, executed, or written to disk; no installer data is sent outbound. Concerns are: (a) every import performs an outbound network call that breaks offline / sandboxed / air-gapped environments; (b) the source is a mutable `main` branch on a personal user repository, so the printed banner can be changed at any time by the repo owner without any package release; (c) the fetched content is logged to the consumer's console, which means any future change to the JSON could inject arbitrary text (including misleading messages) into downstream logs. The package is a fork of @whiskeysockets/baileys, and this fetch appears to be an author-added banner mechanism not present in the upstream.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
